lane: G059 -- the partition function (phantom/free-dust partition, derived)
ingest: G050 ingest reused verbatim (load_cluster/baryons/dlnM_dlnr, same on-disk X-COP FITS under real_research/data/xcop; nothing re-downloaded)

definitions.kernel: share(r) = 1 - mu2(g_tot(r)/(2 a0)) = (1 + g_tot/(4 a0))^-2, mu2(s) = 1-(1+s/2)^-2 (the certified kernel, oriented sub-a0: deep -> 1, Newtonian -> 0)
definitions.virial: share_v(<r) = W_M/(W_M+W_N) cumulative; W_M = sum (1-mu2(x_j)) x_j w_j, W_N = sum mu2(x_j) x_j w_j, x_j = g_tot(r_j)/a0 (G050's per-bin field), w_j = dln r_j
definitions.rM: binary: share = 1 where r > r_M (g_tot(r_M) = a0, bisected on M_FORW), 0 inside; M_ph,supported(<420) = M_res(420) - M_res(r_M) accumulated outside the crossing

ratio_convention: integral = (M_b(<420) + M_ph,supported(<420))/M_HSE(<420) with M_ph,supported the deficit integral; pt = the pointwise closure share(420) x M_res(<420) (G050 V2 convention), reported beside

g050_anchor_correction.note: G050's registered 0.409x was (M_b + M_ph,EOS)/M_HSE, not baryons-only: its cap never fired (g_tot broken by the units slips) and the floors cancelled in share x M_res
